title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) — Endpoint, Cloud & Email
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Purview implementation).

Microsoft Purview portal / Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; Purview features are heavily licensing-/plan-dependent (E5 / E5 Compliance; some preview) and the portal is evolving — availability + paths cited or flagged 'verify your licensing/tenant', never invented. Regulatory/records/legal determinations (retention schedules, file plans, legal holds, insider-risk case actions) deferred to compliance/records/privacy/legal — solutions give the technical method + evidence, not the determination; policies piloted in simulation/test before enforcement. Automation is PowerShell (S&C PowerShell / Graph); no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Stop sensitive data leaving — across endpoints, cloud, and email
problem: Sensitive data walks out through email, cloud sharing, and USB/print on endpoints. This solution implements Purview DLP across the estate: sensitive information types (built-in, custom, EDM, trainable classifiers), DLP policies for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Endpoint (devices), policy tips + user overrides, incident/alert handling, and tuning — all piloted in simulation before enforcement, so leaks are blocked with minimal false positives.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the DLP model: sensitive info types + classifiers, policy locations (email/cloud/Teams/Endpoint), policy tips/overrides, and the simulate→enforce journey.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (E5/E5 Compliance for endpoint DLP, roles, onboarded devices, classification, stakeholders).

Implementation Guide — define sensitive info types/classifiers, build DLP policies per location in simulation, tune false positives, add policy tips + overrides, wire incident handling, then enforce — pilot-first, each policy named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (leaks blocked, false-positive rate low, incidents handled) plus Best Practices for ongoing DLP tuning across endpoint/cloud/email.
short: Implement Purview DLP across endpoint, cloud, and email — sensitive info types + classifiers, policies for Exchange/SPO/OneDrive/Teams/Endpoint (simulated first), policy tips, and incident handling — so leaks are blocked with minimal false positives. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
